featured.image: auto:strait of hormuz US Iran naval ships
featured.imageKeywords: Strait of Hormuz US Iran naval ships Middle East shipping
featured.title: US-Iran Tensions Keep Strait Of Hormuz In Global Focus
featured.content: Tensions surrounding the Strait of Hormuz remain one of the world's biggest geopolitical and economic stories. US President Donald Trump has claimed that the United States has total control of the strategic waterway and has described the American naval presence as a wall of steel. Iran has rejected Washington's claims, while the dispute continues to raise concerns about international shipping, oil supplies and global energy markets.

articles.description: The dispute between Washington and Tehran remains focused on the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most important shipping routes. The confrontation continues to raise concerns about shipping and global energy supplies.

articles.imageKeywords: 2026 total solar eclipse Spain Iceland Europe August 12
articles.title: Europe Witnesses Rare Total Solar Eclipse
articles.description: Millions of people across parts of Europe watched a rare total solar eclipse on August 12. Totality was visible in parts of Iceland and Spain, while other parts of Europe experienced a partial eclipse. NASA confirmed the eclipse path crossed Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic, Spain and a small part of Portugal.

articles.imageKeywords: Spain total solar eclipse crowds August 2026 astronomy
articles.title: Spain Draws Huge Crowds For Historic Eclipse
articles.description: Spanish towns and cities along the eclipse path attracted large numbers of residents and visitors hoping to experience totality. The event became a major scientific, tourism and cultural moment for the country.

articles.description: Extreme heat, drought and wildfire risks continue to put pressure on communities and emergency services across parts of Europe. Authorities are urging residents to follow local health, fire and water-use guidance.

articles.description: Hot and dry conditions continue to increase wildfire risks in vulnerable areas. Firefighters and emergency authorities remain on alert as governments work to protect communities, forests and critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Nigeria Targets Greater Oil And Gas Investment
articles.description: Nigeria's government continues efforts to attract major investment into the oil and gas sector through policy reforms and measures designed to encourage offshore exploration and production. Officials say the reforms could unlock significant new investment, although the exact scale will depend on implementation and investor response.

articles.title: Nigeria Works To Strengthen Oil Production
articles.description: Nigeria continues working to improve oil production and meet its commitments within the OPEC framework. Production levels remain closely watched because oil revenues are important to government finances and foreign-exchange earnings.

articles.title: Nigeria Faces Continued Flash-Flood Risks
articles.description: Weather authorities continue warning communities in vulnerable areas about the possibility of flash floods during the rainy season. Residents are encouraged to monitor official weather information, avoid dangerous floodwaters and follow emergency instructions.

articles.title: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Passes Major Death Toll
articles.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to generate international concern. Reports this week say the death toll has surpassed 2,000, while confirmed infections have risen above 4,300. Health authorities and international partners continue working to contain transmission and provide treatment.
